AAA.route_reason: Investment interests need attributable subsidiary assets and parent-only claims for SOTP.
AAA.intrinsic_blocker: The latest PSE summary ends 1H2014 with negative parent equity; no current investment-asset, liability or recovery bridge is reviewed for the suspended common line.
AAA.source_warning: PSE 1H2014 parent equity is negative PHP20.011m and printed BVPS is negative PHP0.02. The 2026 stock snapshot shows 799,999,981 outstanding versus 800m listed/issued shares; the May 2015 last close is not a current quote.

EG.route_reason: Gaming and investment interests need current realizable NAV and a period-matched common claim.
EG.intrinsic_blocker: The latest PSE summary ends 3Q2019 with zero revenue. Its historical PHP2.659bn parent book is not reconciled to the 2026 30bn-share common line or current asset realization, so no current per-share screen is supported.
EG.source_warning: PSE 3Q2019 printed BVPS PHP0.01 is not consistent with dividing the reported parent equity by the September 2026 share count. The line is suspended and last traded in May 2017; neither stale book nor quote is promoted to value.

NXGEN.route_reason: Renewable project interests require attributable plant-level SOTP and finite asset-life economics.
NXGEN.intrinsic_blocker: Project-level generation, development capex, funding, concession or land rights and parent claims are not sufficiently reconciled for intrinsic SOTP.
NXGEN.source_warning: PSE 1H2026 parent equity is PHP669.334m versus PHP753.275m total equity. Printed BVPS PHP0.51 follows total book; this separate low-reliability screen derives parent book per 1.49bn ordinary common shares instead. A licensed current price and peer calibration were not acquired.

PTT.route_reason: Telecom FCFF needs current operating cash flow, capex, financing and parent-common claims.
